Fixture Data Science Academy

A year-round after-school and weekend data science enrichment academy for high school students, culminating in a summer capstone project.

Eligibility

Open to current 10th-12th grade students with at least one year of algebra.

Program Dates

Rolling admissions; cohorts begin each September and February.

Cost

$150 program fee; need-based waivers available.

How to Apply

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis with no fixed deadline.
